shots.detail_en: MANCANG slaps a crumpled follow-order sheet onto the tea restaurant's glass counter at dawn as a crowd closes in around him.
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The packed tea restaurant: pagers buzzing one after another across the tables, shrimp dumplings gone cold and untouched.
shots.sub: BP 机响了！长虹哥动了！／我的也响——同一条消息！
shots.speaker: 散户甲+散户乙

shots.detail_en: MANCANG is lifted and passed toward the door on the crowd's hands like a returning hero.
shots.sub: 别挤别挤——教主的招牌要挤掉了！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Street montage: arcades, newsstands, fish-ball stalls and appliance shop windows, everyone staring at the same one stock.
shots.sub: 散户的心电图，从来不在医院——在满城的 BP 机里。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Comic stampede into the hall: the crowd knocks over a tea trolley and benches, order slips raining across the floor.
shots.sub: 排队排队！钱要抢，腰也要！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: A callus-covered hand traces the same number on an order slip over and over until the pencil wears through the paper.
shots.sub: 三十年了……我就信这一回。
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: CH watches the human tide from his corner, brow knotting for the first time.
shots.sub: 潮水跟我同向——这不是好消息。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: RED arrives hugging a stack of new-account ledgers, unnaturally thick.
shots.sub: 三天，开户数翻一倍——全是小额，全冲联华实业。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH opens his father's notebook to one page and checks it against the hall.
shots.sub: 爸笔记里有句——人心推的行情，最烫，也最薄。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: At the open, CH taps a single small probe order while behind him the retail army fires thousands of slips in the same direction, shoving Lianhua Industrial into the red.
Rapid cuts: red bars lifting bar after bar / a sea of pagers beeping in sync / MANCANG conducting with his arm / volume columns surging.
shots.sub: 我第一次看见——盘面不是钱推的，是人心推的。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH stares at the board, his look not joy but fear.
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: MANCANG signs for retail traders, a pen stuck in his floral shirt pocket like a triumphant general.
shots.sub: 都别慌——长虹哥不动，我们不动！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: A big red close; the cheering crowd tosses MANCANG into the air.
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's grin freezes mid-air for half a beat — he has glimpsed CH unsmiling before the big screen.
In the emptied hall, mop in hand, CH hand-draws the day's candlestick into his notebook stroke by stroke before the dark screen.
shots.sub: 人心聚得太快……爸，这股潮，我不能认账。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: RED audits the book after hours and turns to the follow-order detail page.
shots.sub: 今天八成买单是跟风单。他们买的不是股——是你。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH's knuckles whiten on the notebook's front page, each word deliberate.
shots.sub: 那就由我——把他们带回来。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Top floor of Lianhua Tower, XIONG reads the report sheet, a smile spreading slowly from the corner of his eye.
shots.sub: 好啊……他亲手把散沙，聚成了一座沙山。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: XIONG is not angry but amused; his bead-twisting fingers stop on a single bead as he raises his eyes.
shots.sub: 散沙聚得越快——风越好借。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.card: 猎人不再砸盘——他要借风。
